name: IN·TERROR·GATION
source:
In-Terror-Gation is a horror investigation game influenced by the works of Lovecraft and Junji Ito. As a psychiatrist at the Innsmount Prison Hospital, you are tasked with the interrogation of a mysterious patient in the hopes of getting to the truth behind a bizarre case of kidnapping.

Ask questions, listen to what she says, and examine your evidence to find the contradictions that may lie within. Only by questioning everything can you figure out the real truth about what happened to this patient, and just what is going on with her.

[From [url=https://olinkalex.itch.io/interrorgation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
In-Terror-Gation是一款受洛夫克拉夫特和伊藤润二作品影响的恐怖调查游戏。作为因斯蒙特监狱医院的精神科医生，你的任务是审问一名神秘的病人，希望找出一桩离奇绑架案背后的真相。

提出问题，听她说的话，并检查你的证据，找出其中可能存在的矛盾。只有质疑一切，你才能弄清楚这个病人发生的事情的真相，以及她到底发生了什么。

[来自[url=https://olinkalex.itch.io/interrorgation]itch.io[/url]]
